name: Fantasies
overview: Scripture warns believers to guard their hearts against indulging in fantasies, especially those of a sexual nature, as seen in Proverbs 6:25 and Matthew 5:28, where lustful thoughts are equated with adultery in the heart. The psalmist highlights the danger of desires exceeding what is good (Psalms 73:7), while Proverbs 28:19 contrasts productive living with pursuing empty or vain pursuits. Instead, Philippians 4:8 encourages focusing the mind on what is pure, honest, and praiseworthy, guiding believers to align their thoughts with Christ, who is the way to the Father (John 14:6).
